climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Riesling, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Cabernet Franc fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water. Loess is fine, wind-blown silt. Fertile and warm, it holds water well but drains poorly. Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it.
soil.top: The topsoil drains fast and warms early in spring. Vines get little water, which keeps crops small and flavors concentrated, but drought bites hard. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.
